inventory.producer: runMerge (packages/knowledge-hub/dataset/.skills/workflow/cycle/scripts/cycle-merge.mjs:218-234) -> hosts.code.merge(), the code-host adapter interface method (github.mjs merge: `gh pr merge <n> --<strategy>`; azure-devops.mjs merge: `az repos pr update --status completed`)
inputs: remote head at merge time (host state, may differ from the head readSignals saw)
representations: canonical: dataset .skills/workflow/cycle/scripts/cycle-merge.mjs + host/{github,azure-devops}.mjs in the 6 workflow skills

classes: runMerge all-green: merge receives headSha === reviewedHead
github merge, headSha 40-hex lowercase: argv carries --match-head-commit <headSha>
github merge, headSha malformed (short, uppercase, argv-injection, non-string): typed HostError, no gh call
github merge, headSha absent: unpinned argv unchanged (interface backward compatible; only caller runMerge always passes it)
CLI run, remote head at merge time == reviewedHead: merged:true on the reviewed head
CLI run, push lands between readSignals and gh pr merge (remote head != reviewedHead): host refuses; merged:false, failed[0].code merge-failed, parkKind halted, card comment, no closure
CLI run, head already moved at readSignals: head-moved park, merge never called (pre-existing)
host refusal (any error thrown by merge): merge-failed park, no closure (pre-existing)
azure-devops merge, headSha != PR lastMergeSourceCommit: HostError, PR not completed
azure-devops merge, headSha == PR source head: completed on that head
strategy merge|rebase with headSha: not reachable from runMerge

azure-devops merge, head reads as headSha on every read but the source head moves before completion (race window): HostError, PR not completed — only an atomic pinned completion (REST PATCH pullRequests with lastMergeSourceCommit.commitId = headSha, refused by the host when stale) passes; a read-then-complete check does not
github merge, headSha empty string: malformed, typed HostError, no gh call
interactions: readSignals(headSha=a) x remote push (b) x adapter merge pin x park/closeStory: the race window of the finding (w5)
adapter pin x host refusal x runMerge catch -> merge-failed (w5 + c4)
azure adapter read(a) x remote push (b) before completion x completion call pin: the r0-1 race window on the Azure adapter (w6-race)
